writing.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
writing.prompt: The plans below show the layout of a university's sports centre now, and how it will look after redevelopment.

writing.instruction: Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
writing.prompt: Some people believe that it is best to encourage children to understand the importance of competition. Others feel it is better to help children to be good at co-operation. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
